newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Newark, N.J.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE
City of Newark
(County of Essex)
New Jersey
General Obligation Self Liquidating Water Utility Bonds
(Qualified Pursuant to P.L. 1976, c.38, the
Municipal
Qualified Bond
(DTC Book-Entry-Only Bonds)

Sealed proposals will be received by the Hon. Ronald W. Jean, Director of Finance (Chief Finaincial Officer''), City of Newark, County of Essex, New Jersey, at his office, located in the Department of Finance, 828 Broad Street, 5th Floor, Newark, New Jersey, at 11:00 a.m., on November 26, 1996, subject to the provisions of the Official Notice of Sale dated November 15, 1996 (the Notice of Sale''). Sale Date: November 26, 1996 Time: bids to be received by 11:00 a.m., award shall be by the Chief Financial Officer prior to 11:00 p.m. on said date.
Dated Date of Bonds: November 1, 1996 Interest Payment Dates: October 1 and April 1 Maturity Schedule:
Principal Principal Principal
October 1 Amount October 1 Amount October 1
Amount
The Bonds maturing on or after October l, 2006 are subject to optional redemption by the City prior to their stated maturity date as described in the Notice of Sale.
Denominations: $5,000 each or any integral multiple

thereof, except that such minimum amount of the last maturing Bond in excess of the largest principal amount thereof equalling a multiple of $5,000 will be in the denomination of $1,000 or any integral multiple thereof, as may be necessary to comply with the proposal of the successful bidder of the Bonds to accept less than the full amount of the Bonds offered officially for public sale in accordance with the Notice of Sale.

Interest Rates: The Bonds will bear interest at the rate or rates specified by the successful bidder determined in accordance with the Notice of Sale. Each proposal must specify a rate or rates, in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1%. Not more than one (1) rate may be named for Bonds of the same maturity, and no rate named for a maturity may be less than the rate named for a prior maturity. The difference
between the highest and lowest rates shall not exceed (2%) percent.
Legal Opinion: Frohling, Hudak & McCarthy, P.C.
Roseland and Newark, New Jersey, and
Banks Erlanger, Newark, New Jersey, Co-Bond
Counsel
Pursuant to Rule 15c2-12 promulgated under the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934, a Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained from the City.
In order to assist bidder in complying with Rule 15c2- 12(b)(5), the City will undertake, pursuant to the
Resolution and a Continuing Disclosure Certificate, to provide annual reports and notices of certain events. A description of this undertaking is set forth in the
preliminary official statement.
It is the policy of the City that Minority Business Enterprises (MBE'') and Women's Business Enterprises
(WBE'') shall have the maximum opportunity to participate in the performance of City contracts.
Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Notice of Sale, and additional information regarding the Bonds,

including additional terms and conditions of the Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the Hon. Ronald W. Jean, Director of Finance, 828 Broad Street, 5th Floor, Newark, New Jersey, (201) 733-8840; Goldman, Beale Associates, 205 Nassau

Street, Princeton, New Jersey 08540, (609) 921-0400; or John G. Hudak, Esq., Frohling, Hudak & McCarthy, P.C. 425 Eagle Rock Avenue, Roseland, New Jersey 07068 (201) 226-4600. Dated: November 15, 1996
DIRECTOR OF FINANCE
(From The Bond Buyer)
